# L2Agent — Structured Web Access for AI Agents

L2Agent is an open-source HTTP + MCP service that fetches web pages and returns
only what AI agents need — forms, fields, buttons, links — as compact JSON.
Token savings are measured per request and reported in every response.

## Base URL

Live API: https://l2agent-production.up.railway.app

Or self-host:
  git clone https://github.com/Emodv/l2agent && cd l2agent
  make build && ./bin/l2agent serve

## Tools (MCP Gateway — stdio)

Run: ./bin/l2agent gateway

- analyze_url(url, agent_id?)       → structured JSON of page (forms, fields, links, token savings)
- submit_form(url, fields, agent_id?) → submit form fields, returns status + response snippet
- get_agent_stats(agent_id)         → measured token usage and savings for an agent

## HTTP Endpoints

GET  /healthz
  Returns: {"status":"ok","store":"memory|redis"}

GET  /v1/analyze?url=<URL>&agent_id=<id>
  Returns structured JSON: title, forms, fields, links, buttons, meta.token_savings

POST /v1/analyze?url=<optional-base-url>&agent_id=<id>
  Body: raw HTML text (Content-Type: text/html or text/plain)
  Returns: same structured JSON as GET — no outbound fetch, parses body directly.
  Use this when you already have the HTML.

POST /v1/submit
  Body: {"url":"...","fields":{"key":"val"},"agent_id":"..."}
  Returns: {"success":true,"status_code":200,"response":"...snippet..."}

GET  /v1/stats?agent_id=<id>
  Returns measured token usage and savings.

## Response shape (analyze)

{
  "url": "https://example.com/signup",
  "title": "Sign Up",
  "forms": [
    {
      "action": "/register",
      "method": "POST",
      "fields": [
        {"name":"email","type":"email","required":true},
        {"name":"password","type":"password","required":true}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "links": [{"text":"Login","href":"/login"}],
  "buttons": [{"text":"Sign Up","type":"submit"}],
  "meta": {
    "raw_tokens_est": 850,
    "optimized_tokens_est": 120,
    "tokens_saved_est": 730,
    "savings_pct": 85.9,
    "note": "estimates use ~4 chars/token"
  }
}

## MCP Config (Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client)

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "l2agent": {
      "command": "/path/to/bin/l2agent",
      "args": ["gateway"]
    }
  }
}

## Auth

No auth in dev mode. Set L2AGENT_API_KEY env var to require X-API-Key header.

## Source

https://github.com/Emodv/l2agent
